messages:
maria_marketing: Quick sync  Planning a public announce for Optimize v1.3 on Tue 10:00 PT. Need final changelog bullets, canonical doc URLs, and canary timing so we can schedule blog, newsletter, and webinar.

noah_eng: Draft changelog almost ready. Will post final bullets by EOD tomorrow. Proposal: staged canary (5% -> 25% -> full).

maria_marketing: Staged okay. Recommend 2h@5%, 4h@25%, full after 24h. That reduces demo risks.

noah_eng: We'll add automatic fallback to the compact model variant and include rollback thresholds.

priya_docs: I can create /docs/release/optimize-1-3 and a quantization guide. Need exact bullets + an anonymized rollout YAML snippet to embed. ETA: tomorrow 12:00 PT.

lena_design: I'll prepare hero art and social tiles. Copy constraint: no absolute latency claims.

maria_marketing: Messaging: highlight "~20% memory reduction" and "fewer tail spikes in internal chat benchmarks (15-25%)". No hard ms numbers.

noah_eng: Deployment plan: canary starts 10:00 PT. Health checks every 15m; auto-rollback if 95th latency >15% vs baseline or error rate >0.5%. release-bot will post stage pings to #release-war-room.

release-bot: Canary scheduled: 1799012345 (10:00 PT). Pre-launch reminder set for 1799012460.

priya_docs: Will post doc URLs here when live and include an anonymized rollout code block and troubleshooting notes.

maria_marketing: Timeline recap: EOD tomorrow  final changelog. Tomorrow 12:00 PT  docs live. Mon AM  design assets. Tue 10:00 PT  announce + canary. Wed  webinar invite to opt-ins.

lena_design: Assets uploaded Monday AM; will drop links.

maria_marketing: Thanks all 44d Flag blockers here ASAP.
